title: Heathrow Airport Is Briefly Locked Down After Spray Is Used in Altercation
summary: One man was arrested after a substance that appeared to be pepper spray was used during a fight in one of the airport’s parking garages, the police said.

title: Sudan facing ‘massive’ humanitarian aid crisis as war rages, WFP warns
